WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        p.SEX,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(l.IGA - l.IGM) AS avg_iga_igm
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
patient_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        SEX,
        avg_pt,
        avg_iga_igm,
        avg_iga_igm / NULLIF(AVG(avg_iga_igm) OVER (), 0) AS ratio_to_overall_mean
    FROM patient_averages
)
SELECT
    SEX,
    AVG(avg_pt) AS average_pt,
    AVG(avg_iga_igm) AS average_iga_igm_difference,
    AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) AS average_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_ratios
GROUP BY SEX;
